description:
In JStock's Portfolio Management view, record three separate buy transactions for META (Meta Platforms Inc.) to track different tax lots. You must add these three specific lots to 'My Portfolio':

1. Date: Mar 15, 2024 | Units: 50 | Price: 326.50 | Broker Fee: 4.99 | Comment: "Post-earnings dip buy"
2. Date: Jun 20, 2024 | Units: 35 | Price: 493.50 | Broker Fee: 4.99 | Comment: "AI momentum play"
3. Date: Sep 10, 2024 | Units: 40 | Price: 561.80 | Broker Fee: 4.99 | Comment: "Reels growth thesis"

To add a transaction, click the 'Buy' button in the Portfolio tab. Ensure all details (Date, Units, Price, Broker Fee, and Comment) are entered exactly as specified for each lot.
